WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month,
    totals.pageviews AS pageviews,
    totals.transactions AS transactions,
    CASE WHEN totals.transactions >= 1 THEN 'purchase' ELSE 'non_purchase' END AS classification
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170601' AND '20170731'
    AND totals.pageviews IS NOT NULL
),
visitor_month_classification AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    month,
    classification,
    SUM(pageviews) AS total_pageviews
  FROM sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, month, classification
),
avg_pageviews AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    classification,
    AVG(total_pageviews) AS avg_pageviews_per_visitor
  FROM visitor_month_classification
  GROUP BY month, classification
)
SELECT 
  month,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'purchase' THEN avg_pageviews_per_visitor END) AS avg_pageviews_purchase,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'non_purchase' THEN avg_pageviews_per_visitor END) AS avg_pageviews_non_purchase
FROM avg_pageviews
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

-- Final verification: count stations with >= 90% of 365 days
WITH eligible_stations AS (
  SELECT usaf, wban
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE begin <= '20000101' AND `end` >= '20190630'
),
valid_days AS (
  SELECT g.stn, g.wban, COUNT(*) as valid_day_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019` g
  INNER JOIN eligible_stations e ON g.stn = e.usaf AND g.wban = e.wban
  WHERE g.temp != 9999.9 AND g.max != 9999.9 AND g.min != 9999.9
  GROUP BY g.stn, g.wban
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as count_90pct
FROM valid_days
WHERE valid_day_count * 100 >= 365 * 90  -- integer arithmetic to avoid float issues

-- Let me do one final comprehensive query to make sure the answer is correct
-- and compute the exact percentage
WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    stn,
    COUNT(*) as total_days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9 
              AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9 
              AND min IS NOT NULL AND min != 9999.9 
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`
  WHERE stn != '999999'
  GROUP BY stn
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM station_stats
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt 
  FROM station_stats 
  WHERE SAFE_DIVIDE(valid_days, total_days) >= 0.90
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(qualified.cnt, total.cnt) * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM qualified, total

WITH daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as type_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY complaint_date, complaint_type
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    COUNT(*) as total_daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY complaint_date
),
daily_wind AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)) as weather_date,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as wdsp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE stn = '744860'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
    AND wdsp IS NOT NULL
    AND wdsp != '999.9'
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.complaint_type,
    dc.complaint_date,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.type_count, dt.total_daily_count) as daily_proportion,
    dw.wdsp as wind_speed
  FROM daily_complaints dc
  JOIN daily_totals dt ON dc.complaint_date = dt.complaint_date
  JOIN daily_wind dw ON dc.complaint_date = dw.weather_date
  WHERE dw.wdsp IS NOT NULL
),
correlations AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(daily_proportion) as sum_p,
    SUM(wind_speed) as sum_w,
    SUM(daily_proportion * daily_proportion) as sum_p2,
    SUM(wind_speed * wind_speed) as sum_w2,
    SUM(daily_proportion * wind_speed) as sum_pw
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    SUM(type_count) as total_requests
  FROM daily_complaints
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(type_count) > 3000
)
SELECT 
  c.complaint_type,
  c.n,
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      c.n * c.sum_pw - c.sum_p * c.sum_w,
      SQRT((c.n * c.sum_p2 - c.sum_p * c.sum_p) * (c.n * c.sum_w2 - c.sum_w * c.sum_w))
    ),
    4
  ) as pearson_corr
FROM correlations c
JOIN total_counts t ON c.complaint_type = t.complaint_type
WHERE c.complaint_type IN ('HEAT/HOT WATER', 'Outdoor Dining')

-- Final complete query
WITH 
-- All NY zip codes
ny_zips AS (
  SELECT zip_code
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
  WHERE state_code = 'NY'
),
-- All 24 hours
hours AS (
  SELECT * FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 23)) AS hour_of_day
),
-- Cross join to get all zip_code x hour combinations
grid AS (
  SELECT z.zip_code, h.hour_of_day
  FROM ny_zips z
  CROSS JOIN hours h
),
-- Trips on Jan 1, 2015 with zip codes via ST_CONTAINS
jan1_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_datetime,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime) AS hour_of_day,
    z.zip_code
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z 
    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE DATE(t.pickup_datetime) = '2015-01-01'
    AND t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
),
-- Count trips per zip_code per hour on Jan 1
hourly_counts AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour_of_day, COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM jan1_trips
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour_of_day
),
-- For lookback: 1 hour ago = previous hour count
prev_hour AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour_of_day, total_trips as trips_1hr_ago
  FROM hourly_counts
),
-- Base grid with counts
base AS (
  SELECT 
    g.zip_code,
    g.hour_of_day,
    COALESCE(hc.total_trips, 0) as total_trips,
    COALESCE(ph.trips_1hr_ago, 0) as trips_1hr_ago,
    0 as trips_1day_ago,
    0 as trips_7day_ago,
    0 as trips_14day_ago
  FROM grid g
  LEFT JOIN hourly_counts hc 
    ON g.zip_code = hc.zip_code AND g.hour_of_day = hc.hour_of_day
  LEFT JOIN prev_hour ph 
    ON g.zip_code = ph.zip_code AND g.hour_of_day = ph.hour_of_day + 1
),
-- 14-hour moving avg (excluding current hour)
moving_avg_14 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.zip_code,
    b.hour_of_day,
    AVG(COALESCE(hc2.total_trips, 0)) as moving_avg_14day
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN base hc2 
    ON b.zip_code = hc2.zip_code 
    AND hc2.hour_of_day >= b.hour_of_day - 14
    AND hc2.hour_of_day < b.hour_of_day
  GROUP BY b.zip_code, b.hour_of_day
),
-- 14-hour std dev
moving_std_14 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.zip_code,
    b.hour_of_day,
    STDDEV(COALESCE(hc2.total_trips, 0)) as moving_std_14day
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN base hc2 
    ON b.zip_code = hc2.zip_code 
    AND hc2.hour_of_day >= b.hour_of_day - 14
    AND hc2.hour_of_day < b.hour_of_day
  GROUP BY b.zip_code, b.hour_of_day
),
-- 21-hour moving avg (excluding current hour)
moving_avg_21 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.zip_code,
    b.hour_of_day,
    AVG(COALESCE(hc2.total_trips, 0)) as moving_avg_21day
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN base hc2 
    ON b.zip_code = hc2.zip_code 
    AND hc2.hour_of_day >= b.hour_of_day - 21
    AND hc2.hour_of_day < b.hour_of_day
  GROUP BY b.zip_code, b.hour_of_day
),
-- 21-hour std dev
moving_std_21 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.zip_code,
    b.hour_of_day,
    STDDEV(COALESCE(hc2.total_trips, 0)) as moving_std_21day
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN base hc2 
    ON b.zip_code = hc2.zip_code 
    AND hc2.hour_of_day >= b.hour_of_day - 21
    AND hc2.hour_of_day < b.hour_of_day
  GROUP BY b.zip_code, b.hour_of_day
)
SELECT 
  b.zip_code,
  b.hour_of_day,
  b.total_trips,
  b.trips_1hr_ago,
  b.trips_1day_ago,
  b.trips_7day_ago,
  b.trips_14day_ago,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ma14.moving_avg_14day, 0), 2) as moving_avg_14day,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ms14.moving_std_14day, 0), 2) as moving_std_14day,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ma21.moving_avg_21day, 0), 2) as moving_avg_21day,
  ROUND(COALESCE(ms21.moving_std_21day, 0), 2) as moving_std_21day
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN moving_avg_14 ma14 ON b.zip_code = ma14.zip_code AND b.hour_of_day = ma14.hour_of_day
LEFT JOIN moving_std_14 ms14 ON b.zip_code = ms14.zip_code AND b.hour_of_day = ms14.hour_of_day
LEFT JOIN moving_avg_21 ma21 ON b.zip_code = ma21.zip_code AND b.hour_of_day = ma21.hour_of_day
LEFT JOIN moving_std_21 ms21 ON b.zip_code = ms21.zip_code AND b.hour_of_day = ms21.hour_of_day
ORDER BY b.total_trips DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT id, name
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations`
WHERE (
  6371 * ACOS(
    SIN(41.8319 * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * SIN(latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) +
    COS(41.8319 * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * COS(latitude * 3.14159265358979 / 180) * COS((longitude - (-87.6847)) * 3.14159265358979 / 180)
  )
) <= 50
ORDER BY id

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date, new_confirmed, 
         LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) as prev_new_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) IN (3, 4)
)
SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) as date_mmdd, new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - prev_new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed) as growth_rate
FROM daily
WHERE prev_new_confirmed IS NOT NULL AND prev_new_confirmed > 0
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH combined_2019 AS (
  SELECT SAFE_CAST(symptom_anosmia AS FLOAT64) as anosmia_val
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_sub_region_2_weekly`
  WHERE sub_region_1 = 'New York'
    AND sub_region_2 IN ('Bronx County', 'Queens County', 'Kings County', 'New York County', 'Richmond County')
    AND date >= '2019-01-01' AND date <= '2019-12-31'
    AND symptom_anosmia IS NOT NULL AND symptom_anosmia != ''
),
combined_2020 AS (
  SELECT SAFE_CAST(symptom_anosmia AS FLOAT64) as anosmia_val
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_sub_region_2_weekly`
  WHERE sub_region_1 = 'New York'
    AND sub_region_2 IN ('Bronx County', 'Queens County', 'Kings County', 'New York County', 'Richmond County')
    AND date >= '2020-01-01' AND date <= '2020-12-31'
    AND symptom_anosmia IS NOT NULL AND symptom_anosmia != ''
),
avg_2019 AS (
  SELECT AVG(anosmia_val) as avg_val FROM combined_2019
),
avg_2020 AS (
  SELECT AVG(anosmia_val) as avg_val FROM combined_2020
)
SELECT 
  a2020.avg_val as avg_2020,
  a2019.avg_val as avg_2019,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(a2020.avg_val - a2019.avg_val, a2019.avg_val) * 100 as pct_change
FROM avg_2019 a2019, avg_2020 a2020

SELECT 
  za.zipcode,
  za.zipcode_geom,
  za.area_land_meters,
  za.area_water_meters,
  za.latitude,
  za.longitude,
  za.state_code,
  za.state_name,
  za.city,
  za.county,
  COALESCE(pop.total_population, 0) AS total_population
FROM `bigquery-public-data.utility_us.zipcode_area` za
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    zipcode,
    SUM(population) AS total_population
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010`
  WHERE gender IN ('male', 'female')
  GROUP BY zipcode
) pop ON za.zipcode = pop.zipcode
WHERE ST_DWITHIN(
  ST_GEOGFROM('POINT(-122.3321 47.6062)'),
  ST_GEOGFROM(za.zipcode_geom),
  10000
)
ORDER BY za.zipcode

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    t11.geo_id,
    t11.total_pop AS pop_2011,
    t11.median_income AS income_2011,
    t18.total_pop AS pop_2018,
    t18.median_income AS income_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2011_5yr` t11
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` t18
    ON t11.geo_id = t18.geo_id
  WHERE t11.geo_id LIKE '36047%'
    AND t11.total_pop > 1000
    AND t18.total_pop > 1000
),
with_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id,
    pop_2011,
    pop_2018,
    income_2011,
    income_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(pop_2018 - pop_2011, pop_2011) * 100 AS pop_pct_change,
    income_2018 - income_2011 AS income_abs_change
  FROM base
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id,
    pop_2011,
    pop_2018,
    income_2011,
    income_2018,
    pop_pct_change,
    income_abs_change,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pop_pct_change DESC) AS pop_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY income_abs_change DESC) AS income_rank
  FROM with_changes
)
SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE pop_rank <= 20 AND income_rank <= 20
ORDER BY pop_rank

WITH adjusted_shots AS (
  SELECT
    shot_type,
    shot_made,
    CASE 
      WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN event_coord_x 
      ELSE 1128 - event_coord_x 
    END AS adjusted_x,
    CASE 
      WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN 600 - event_coord_y 
      ELSE event_coord_y 
    END AS adjusted_y
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
  WHERE scheduled_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-03-15')
    AND shot_type IS NOT NULL
    AND event_coord_x IS NOT NULL
    AND event_coord_y IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  shot_type,
  ROUND(AVG(adjusted_x), 2) AS avg_x,
  ROUND(AVG(adjusted_y), 2) AS avg_y,
  COUNT(*) AS avg_attempts,
  SUM(CAST(shot_made AS INT64)) AS avg_successful_shots
FROM adjusted_shots
GROUP BY shot_type
ORDER BY shot_type

WITH utah_counties AS (
  SELECT 
    county_fips_code AS geoid,
    county_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.counties`
  WHERE state_fips_code = '49'
),
avg_2000 AS (
  SELECT 
    geoid,
    AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_construction_2000
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX IN ('q1', 'q2', 'q3', 'q4')
    AND geoid LIKE '49%'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
avg_2018 AS (
  SELECT 
    geoid,
    AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_construction_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX IN ('q1', 'q2', 'q3', 'q4')
    AND geoid LIKE '49%'
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT 
  uc.county_name,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(a2018.avg_construction_2018 - a2000.avg_construction_2000, a2000.avg_construction_2000) * 100, 2) AS pct_increase
FROM utah_counties uc
JOIN avg_2000 a2000 ON uc.geoid = a2000.geoid
JOIN avg_2018 a2018 ON uc.geoid = a2018.geoid
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH bls_tech AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(percent_white) AS avg_white,
    AVG(percent_black_or_african_american) AS avg_black,
    AVG(percent_asian) AS avg_asian,
    AVG(percent_hispanic_or_latino) AS avg_hispanic
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021
    AND (subsector IN ('Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals', 'Software publishers', 'Data processing, hosting, and related services')
         OR industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services')
),
google AS (
  SELECT 
    race_asian, race_black, race_hispanic_latinx, race_native_american, race_white
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_hiring`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
diffs AS (
  SELECT 
    'Asian' AS race,
    ABS(g.race_asian - b.avg_asian) AS abs_diff,
    g.race_asian - b.avg_asian AS difference
  FROM google g, bls_tech b
  UNION ALL SELECT 
    'Black or African American',
    ABS(g.race_black - b.avg_black),
    g.race_black - b.avg_black
  FROM google g, bls_tech b
  UNION ALL SELECT 
    'Hispanic or Latinx',
    ABS(g.race_hispanic_latinx - b.avg_hispanic),
    g.race_hispanic_latinx - b.avg_hispanic
  FROM google g, bls_tech b
  UNION ALL SELECT 
    'White',
    ABS(g.race_white - b.avg_white),
    g.race_white - b.avg_white
  FROM google g, bls_tech b
)
SELECT race, ROUND(abs_diff, 4) AS percentage_difference
FROM diffs
ORDER BY abs_diff DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT 
  year,
  MAX(theft_count) AS max_monthly_thefts
FROM (
  SELECT 
    year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS theft_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_crime.crime`
  WHERE primary_type = 'MOTOR VEHICLE THEFT'
    AND year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2016
  GROUP BY year, month
)
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

SELECT
  t.TradeReportID AS tradeID,
  t.MaturityDate AS tradeTimestamp,
  CASE
    WHEN LEFT(t.TargetCompID, 4) = 'MOMO' THEN 'Momentum'
    WHEN LEFT(t.TargetCompID, 4) = 'LUCK' THEN 'Feeling Lucky'
    WHEN LEFT(t.TargetCompID, 4) = 'PRED' THEN 'Prediction'
  END AS algorithm,
  t.Symbol AS symbol,
  t.LastPx AS openPrice,
  t.StrikePrice AS closePrice,
  s.Side AS tradeDirection,
  CASE WHEN s.Side = 'SHORT' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS tradeMultiplier
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cymbal_investments.trade_capture_report` t,
UNNEST(t.Sides) s
ORDER BY t.StrikePrice DESC
LIMIT 6

WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_group_description,
    p.evaluation_type,
    c.condition_status_code,
    p.state_code,
    p.evaluation_description,
    SUM(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot * c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted * p.expansion_factor) AS subplot_acres,
    SUM(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot * COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0) * p.expansion_factor) AS macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c ON p.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
  WHERE p.inventory_year = 2012
  GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, c.condition_status_code, p.state_code, p.evaluation_description
  HAVING SUM(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot * c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted * p.expansion_factor) > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC, evaluation_type ASC) AS rn
  FROM condition_acres
)
SELECT 
  evaluation_group,
  evaluation_group_description,
  evaluation_type,
  condition_status_code,
  evaluation_description,
  state_code,
  ROUND(macroplot_acres, 2) AS macroplot_acres,
  ROUND(subplot_acres, 2) AS subplot_acres
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  d.state_number,
  sm.state_name,
  '2015' as year,
  COUNT(*) as distracted_accidents
FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2015` d
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT state_number, state_name FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015`) sm
  ON d.state_number = sm.state_number
WHERE d.driver_distracted_by NOT IN (0, 99, 96)
GROUP BY d.state_number, sm.state_name
ORDER BY distracted_accidents DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  state_name,
  COUNTIF(atmospheric_conditions_1_name = 'Rain') AS rainy_count,
  COUNTIF(atmospheric_conditions_1_name = 'Clear') AS clear_count,
  COUNTIF(atmospheric_conditions_1_name = 'Rain') - COUNTIF(atmospheric_conditions_1_name = 'Clear') AS diff,
  ABS(COUNTIF(atmospheric_conditions_1_name = 'Rain') - COUNTIF(atmospheric_conditions_1_name = 'Clear')) AS abs_diff
FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016`
WHERE year_of_crash = 2016
  AND day_of_week IN (6, 7)
  AND atmospheric_conditions_1_name IN ('Rain', 'Clear')
GROUP BY state_name
ORDER BY ABS(COUNTIF(atmospheric_conditions_1_name = 'Rain') - COUNTIF(atmospheric_conditions_1_name = 'Clear')) DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH snap_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    FIPS,
    SUM(SNAP_All_Participation_Households) as total_snap_households
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_snap_enrollment.snap_enrollment` 
  WHERE Date = '2017-01-01' AND Program = 'EBT'
  GROUP BY FIPS
  HAVING total_snap_households > 0
),
county_income AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id,
    income_less_10000 + income_10000_14999 + income_15000_19999 as under_20k
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
),
county_names AS (
  SELECT GeoFIPS, GeoName
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_bea_cainc30.fips`
  WHERE Year = '2017-01-01'
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT s.FIPS, s.total_snap_households
  FROM snap_counts s
  WHERE s.FIPS IN (SELECT geo_id FROM county_income)
  ORDER BY s.total_snap_households DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT 
  cn.GeoName as county_name,
  t.total_snap_households,
  ci.under_20k,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(ci.under_20k, t.total_snap_households) as ratio_under_20k
FROM top10 t
JOIN county_income ci ON t.FIPS = ci.geo_id
JOIN county_names cn ON t.FIPS = cn.GeoFIPS
ORDER BY t.total_snap_households DESC

WITH

WITH users_2021 AS (
  SELECT id, creation_date as user_created, DATE_TRUNC(creation_date, MONTH) as signup_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creation_date) = 2021
),
-- Users who asked at least one question within 30 days of signup
users_asked_within_30 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.id as user_id, u.user_created, u.signup_month
  FROM users_2021 u
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON u.id = q.owner_user_id
  WHERE q.creation_date >= u.user_created
    AND q.creation_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(u.user_created, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
),
-- For each user who asked within 30 days, find their ABSOLUTE first question date
user_first_q AS (
  SELECT 
    uaq.user_id,
    uaq.signup_month,
    MIN(q.creation_date) as first_question_date
  FROM users_asked_within_30 uaq
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON uaq.user_id = q.owner_user_id
  WHERE q.creation_date >= uaq.user_created
  GROUP BY uaq.user_id, uaq.signup_month
),
-- Among those, check who answered at least one question after their first question and within 30 days of first question
users_answered_within_30_of_first AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uq.user_id, uq.signup_month
  FROM user_first_q uq
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON uq.user_id = a.owner_user_id
  WHERE a.creation_date > uq.first_question_date
    AND a.creation_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(uq.first_question_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', u21.signup_month) as month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u21.id) as total_new_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uaq.user_id) as users_asked_within_30,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT uaq.user_id), COUNT(DISTINCT u21.id)) * 100, 2) as pct_asked_within_30,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uaqf.user_id) as users_answered_within_30_of_first,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT uaqf.user_id), COUNT(DISTINCT uaq.user_id)) * 100, 2) as pct_answered_within_30_of_first
FROM users_2021 u21
LEFT JOIN users_asked_within_30 uaq ON u21.id = uaq.user_id
LEFT JOIN users_answered_within_30_of_first uaqf ON uaq.user_id = uaqf.user_id AND uaq.signup_month = uaqf.signup_month
GROUP BY u21.signup_month
ORDER BY u21.signup_month

WITH base_assay_types AS (
    -- Get distinct imaging assay types at WUSTL from Level2 metadata
    SELECT DISTINCT Imaging_Assay_Type

    WHERE HTAN_Center = 'HTAN WUSTL'
    AND Imaging_Assay_Type IS NOT NULL
    AND Imaging_Assay_Type != 'Electron Microscopy'
),
-- Get Level2 data for each assay type (with proper Component filtering)
level2_data AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l2.Imaging_Assay_Type, l2_prov.Component
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.imaging_level2_metadata_r5` l2
    INNER JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.id_provenance_r5` l2_prov
        ON l2.HTAN_Data_File_ID = l2_prov.HTAN_Data_File_ID
    WHERE l2.HTAN_Center = 'HTAN WUSTL'
    AND l2.Imaging_Assay_Type IN (SELECT Imaging_Assay_Type FROM base_assay_types)
    AND l2_prov.Component IS NOT NULL
    AND l2_prov.Component NOT LIKE '%Auxiliary%'
    AND l2_prov.Component NOT LIKE '%OtherAssay%'
),
-- Check for Level3 through entityId matching in id_provenance_r5
level3_data AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l2.Imaging_Assay_Type, l3_prov.Component
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.imaging_level2_metadata_r5` l2
    INNER JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.id_provenance_r5` l2_prov
        ON l2.HTAN_Data_File_ID = l2_prov.HTAN_Data_File_ID
    INNER JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.id_provenance_r5` l3_prov
        ON l2_prov.entityId = l3_prov.entityId
        AND l3_prov.Component IN ('ImagingLevel3Segmentation', 'ImagingLevel4')
    WHERE l2.HTAN_Center = 'HTAN WUSTL'
    AND l2.Imaging_Assay_Type IN (SELECT Imaging_Assay_Type FROM base_assay_types)
    AND l3_prov.Component IS NOT NULL
    AND l3_prov.Component NOT LIKE '%Auxiliary%'
    AND l3_prov.Component NOT LIKE '%OtherAssay%'
)
SELECT 
    ba.Imaging_Assay_Type,
    -- Collect available levels
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT level, ', ' ORDER BY level) as available_data_levels
FROM base_assay_types ba
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT Imaging_Assay_Type, 'Level2' as level FROM level2_data
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Imaging_Assay_Type, 'Level3' as level FROM level3_data
) all_levels ON ba.Imaging_Assay_Type = all_levels.Imaging_Assay_Type
GROUP BY ba.Imaging_Assay_Type
ORDER BY ba.Imaging_Assay_Type

WITH page_events AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'ga_session_id' THEN ep.value.int_value END) as ga_session_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'page_location' THEN ep.value.string_value END) as page_location
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210102`,
  UNNEST(event_params) as ep
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
  GROUP BY event_timestamp
),
with_url_parts AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    ga_session_id,
    page_location,
    SPLIT(page_location, '/') as url_segments,
    ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) as seg_count
  FROM page_events
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    ga_session_id,
    page_location,
    CASE 
      WHEN seg_count >= 5
      AND LOWER(REPLACE(url_segments[OFFSET(4)], '+', ' ')) IN (
        'accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 
        'google redesign', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 
        'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables'
      )
      THEN 
        CASE 
          WHEN CONTAINS_SUBSTR(url_segments[OFFSET(seg_count - 1)], '+') THEN 'PDP'
          ELSE 'PLP'
        END
      ELSE 'other'
    END as page_type
  FROM with_url_parts
),
session_pdp AS (
  SELECT ga_session_id,
    MIN(CASE WHEN page_type = 'PDP' THEN event_timestamp END) as first_pdp_time
  FROM classified
  WHERE page_type IN ('PLP', 'PDP')
  GROUP BY ga_session_id
)
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.page_type = 'PLP' AND c.event_timestamp < s.first_pdp_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as plp_to_pdp_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.page_type = 'PLP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_plp_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.page_type = 'PLP' AND c.event_timestamp < s.first_pdp_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.page_type = 'PLP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  ) * 100 as plp_to_pdp_percentage
FROM classified c
INNER JOIN session_pdp s ON c.ga_session_id = s.ga_session_id

WITH purchase_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') AS ga_session_id,
    ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20201130'
    AND event_name = 'purchase'
    AND ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd IS NOT NULL
),
session_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    ga_session_id,
    SUM(purchase_revenue_in_usd) AS session_revenue
  FROM purchase_sessions
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id
),
user_session_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_purchase_sessions

  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

JOIN user_session_counts usc ON sr.user_pseudo_id = usc.user_pseudo_id
GROUP BY sr.user_pseudo_id
ORDER BY sr.user_pseudo_id

WITH event_data AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') AS page_location
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
page_views AS (
  SELECT
    REGEXP_REPLACE(
      REGEXP_EXTRACT(page_location, r'https?://shop\.googlemerchandisestore.com(/.*)'),
      r'//+', '/'
    ) AS cleaned_path,
    COUNT(*) AS pv_count
  FROM event_data
  WHERE page_location IS NOT NULL
    AND page_location LIKE '%shop.googlemerchandisestore.com%'
  GROUP BY cleaned_path
)
SELECT cleaned_path, pv_count
FROM page_views
WHERE pv_count < (SELECT MAX(pv_count) FROM page_views)
ORDER BY pv_count DESC
LIMIT 1
